metadata.title: Finite triangular checks support the sampled cases

claim.summary: Direct integer sums and n(n+1)/2 agreed for n=1, 10, and 100 in the observed arithmetic check.

applicability: Exact integer arithmetic for the three sampled positive integer inputs.
limitations: Three finite cases are not a proof of the formula for every positive integer.

body:
# Lesson from the triangular sum check

The check compared direct integer sums with n*(n+1)//2 at n=1, 10, and 100 and passed. Retain these as regression examples. Their agreement does not prove the formula for untested values.
